name: team_planning_move_change
description: Move a change in a step of a Team Planning plan's timeline to the step before or after, so it happens a step earlier or later. facet is assignment, position or departure; direction is earlier or later. Every entry of that subject and facet goes across, so undo and redo work as before, and team_planning_undo_change in the step it reached takes the whole move back. Moving earlier goes to the step before on the path; moving later goes to the step after, and when more than one follows, to_scenario_id names which. Refused when the step it would reach already changes that facet (the refusal names that change), when either step is half of a split, when there is no step that way, for a departure whose date falls outside the period of the step it would reach, or unless the caller is an editor.
